verdict.rationale: Casium's own platform documents a guided checklist and task list for moving cases forward, and it positions itself as replacing scattered email threads and back-and-forth with one platform through a live client portal. However, document uploads and automated reminders are never explicitly described, so the evidence-collection workflow is only partly shown. Missing for 10: explicit document/evidence upload capability, automated reminders or nudges, detail on how the checklist drives evidence collection, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, evidence and document collection runs through a structured workflow (checklists, uploads, reminders) rather than email attachments

citations.quote: Casium keeps your case moving with a guided checklist, a team preparing your petition in parallel, and clear deadlines you can count on.
A clear task list, direct access to real attorneys, and answers measured in minutes and hours, not days.
We replace the spreadsheets, the back-and-forth between employees and legal, and the scattered email threads with one intelligent platform.
A live client portal exists (portal.casium.com sign-in linked from the site header) — the case dashboard is a real product surface.
